items.title: Bobby Johnson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: [(note)] ...played in the Pensacola High School Band where his bandmates included Benny Carter and Panama Francis.

ctx.x: He got together a bunch of older guys, like Panama Francis on drums, myself, Milt Hinton on bass, the great Clark Terry — can you think of Clark Terry as an old man? Clark Terry on trumpet, Red Richards, God rest his soul he just passed away, Red Richards. Then Eddie Barefield, and we recorded. I’ll give you one of the tapes, and Milt Hinton is — I was with Milt Hinton when he was young with Cab Calloway — when the whole world was young — with Cab Calloway. You have heard of Panama Francis?
